summary: This is a prospectus filed under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $2.105 billion asset-backed securitization (Honda Auto Receivables 2026-2 Owner Trust) by American Honda Receivables LLC as depositor. The offering comprises five classes of notes (A-1, A-2a, A-2b, A-3, A-4) backed by auto loans on Honda/Acura vehicles, with credit enhancement from excess interest, subordination, reserve fund, and yield supplement. The notes are being publicly offered with joint bookrunners Barclays, Mizuho, SMBC Nikko, and Societe Generale. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activism, or strategic reviews; this is a routine structured finance shelf takedown. No risk-arb angle applies.
